main_text.p: Syria urbe. Nondum obiisse eum anno H. 769. patet ex ipsius scriptis.

Lamiatol' Ajam ] Poëma est cujus author ابو اسمعيل الحسين بن علي الاصفهاني Abu Ismael Al-Hosain Ebn Ali AlAsphahani, qui الطغرائي Altograi appellationem sortitus est à munere vel peritia scribendi الطغرا Altograi. i.e. implexam istam & crassioris ductus Scripturam quae diplomatis principum praemitti apud ipsos solet, nomina & titulos eorum continens. Interfectus est circa annum H. 515 plus quam sexagenarius.

Abu Jaafar Grammaticus ] [c. ابو جعفر احمد بن محمد النحاس Abu Jaafar Ahmed Ebn Mohammed, &c, AlNahhas, multa & praeclara scripsit, inter caetera, commentarium in septem Moallakat. periit an. H.338. vel juxta alios 339. Ebn Chalec. 161.
Mohalhel ] cui nomen عدي Ada aut ربيعة Rabio, teste auctore Kamusi, at Aljauhario, Amriol Kais امرئ القيس [c. ut in Mezbar ابن ربيعة Ebn Rabiah. Ib.
Thaalabus ] ثعلب Grammaticus celebris, cui nomen ابو العباس احمد Abul Abbas Ahmed, natus anno H.200. mortuus 291. Ebn Chal. 162.
جاحظ ابو عثمان عمرو بن بحر المعروف بالجاحظ Jahedh ] Abu Othman Amrus Ebn Bahr, appellatus Aljahedh à quo secta Motazelorum الجاحظ obiit anno H. 255. 164.

Asmaiius ] ابو سعيد عبد الملك بن قريب المعروف بالاصمعي Abu Said Addol Malec Ebn Karib, &c. vulgo AlAsmai dictus, ab avo scil. ipsius cui nomen اصمع Asmao. natus est an H.123. vel juxta alios 122. mortuus circa an. 216. Ebn Chal. 164.

page.notes: The Arabic forms and vowel marks are small and faint; the transcription of several Arabic words (e.g. the name after "Mezbar", the word before "Ebn Rabiah") is uncertain and may need checking against a larger scan. The "[c." before the Arabic in the Abu Jaafar entry is printed as shown. The "Ebn" spellings and the "Mohalhel" entry's "Ada / Rabio" are copied as printed.
